column2: Add-ons are extra cars, downloaded from the launcher. In game, each player rents one at the RALLI-VUOKRAAMO garage: with their colour and number, or with their own livery. The Fiad 131 stays free in F10.
Go to the RALLI-VUOKRAAMO garage, in Ässäkylä, left of the CARDINAL shop: it has its own spot on the map (M).
The rental agent is in the left-hand room, behind the desk: click on the agent, pick the car and a free colour, then pay.
The car waits for you in front of the garage and replaces your current car. It is returned when you leave the game.
The price runs from 240 to 490 mk depending on the power-to-weight ratio. You only pay if the host accepts. The menu offers the rally cars installed on your PC.

The garage appears when the host has ticked \"CARDINAL parts shop\" and \"Players' Fiad 131 (F10)\" in Settings > Co-op > MWCoop additions: no separate setting. Without the garage, there are no rally cars at all: the F10 panel says so.

Since 1.14: the Fiad 131 (F10) and the add-on cars (launcher's Character > Add-ons page, rented at the RALLI-VUOKRAAMO garage), built on the RUSCKO, with their gravel wheels and the rally SATSUMA's handling; the weekend rally with them.
